decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is a low-cost accessory that extends the established track system and keeps that system's value open, so holding it costs little even though recent evidence is missing.

This single LED luminaire got only a mention at launch and has had four years for uncertainty to resolve, but it sits close to the core range and is cheap to keep, so dropping it is plausible but not yet clearly justified.

The home automation server box is a platform option for the firm's smart home direction, where the value is still unfolding, so keeping it open fits the strategy despite the risk of technological obsolescence.

The luminaire family had a dedicated page, which signals commitment, and as a family close to the core it costs little to maintain, although premium lighting collections are often refreshed after about four years.
